name: Poongsan Holdings Corporation
summary: Poongsan Holdings Corporation manufactures and sells copper and nonferrous metal products worldwide. The company offers copper, brozen, alloyed, magnetic, nickel based brazing alloys, copper alloys, nano, coated, aluminum, tin, and copper silver powders; and inspection apparatus such as SEM, XRF, ICP-OES, DC-Bias, carbon and oxygen analyzer, L.P.S.A, B-H analyzer, vickers hardness tester, metallurgical microscope, toll microscope, rockwell hardness tester, brinell haardness tester, universal testing machine, surface roughness tester, height micrometer, microscope, sieve, Ro-tap, hall flowmeter, moisture tester, and tab density tester.
